review.decision: Show applicable maintenance in the initial Doctor summary and keep it read-only
review.notes: Exercise the ordinary interactive Doctor dispatch with a temporary HOME and known process/service observations. Check informational readiness independently of unrelated repairs. The fixture does not verify an actual Mac reboot or migration.

cases.description: Ordinary Doctor shows the applicable v2 migration and its next command
cases.setup: Use private grouped v2 storage and an isolated terminal with read-only launchd fixtures.
cases.action: Run bare doctor from a PTY and inspect the result summary.
cases.expected: The summary names the optional v3 migration and gtmux doctor --fix. It offers no migration confirmation and leaves the original path, layout marker and service state intact.

cases.description: Ordinary Doctor tells a reader why to defer an applicable migration
cases.setup: Use grouped v2 storage and observe a tmux terminal, a live tmux process, a menu-bar process or an occupied workflow destination.
cases.action: Run bare doctor and inspect the summary for the concrete reason and the pre-restore next step.
cases.expected: The note is visible at the end, distinguishes deferral from readiness and advises running the migration wizard only in the right window. No migration or service change is attempted.

cases.description: Completed, inconsistent or inapplicable layouts never show fresh v2 migration advice
cases.setup: Use isolated flat, already migrated and interrupted or conflicting fixtures.
cases.action: Run ordinary Doctor and read the diagnostic.
cases.expected: Flat and verified v3 states have no optional v2 migration notice. Existing interrupted and conflicting layouts retain their original guidance instead of a fresh-migration offer.
